account-locked: Akọọlẹ ti wa ni titiipa fun igba diẹ nitori ọpọlọpọ awọn igbiyanju iwọle ti kuna. Jọwọ gbiyanju lẹẹkansi nigbamii.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel wa fun SuperAdmin nikan, ni agbegbe Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Pẹlu WeKan ninu Weddy, Cloud Panel n pese ọpọlọpọ agbegbe WeKan lati olupin kan, ọkọọkan pẹlu data tirẹ. Ni agbegbe Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin n ṣakoso awọn agbegbe ati CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Pẹlu kọkọrọ CloudFlare API, agbegbe ti agbegbe-ẹka rẹ wa ninu akọọlẹ CloudFlare rẹ yoo gba igbasilẹ DNS ti a fi proxy ṣe ati iwe-ẹri CloudFlare Origin. Awọn agbegbe miiran gba iwe-ẹri Let's Encrypt. A fi kọkọrọ naa pamọ sori olupin ati pe a ko ni fi han mọ.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Ko si kọkọrọ CloudFlare API ti a fi pamọ: gbogbo agbegbe gba iwe-ẹri Let's Encrypt.
cloudflare-api-key-set: A ti fi kọkọrọ CloudFlare API pamọ.

error-notAuthorized: A ko fun ọ ni aṣẹ lati wo oju-iwe yii.
error-username-taken: Orukọ olumulo yii ti gba tẹlẹ
